# Lana Luxe Events

> Lana Luxe Events hires soft play, jumping castles, party fun and event styling for children's celebrations and events across Johannesburg and Pretoria, South Africa. Hire options are listed with prices and inclusions, and every enquiry is confirmed by the team before anything is reserved.

Lana Luxe Events is a party and event hire business based in Gauteng, South Africa. It supplies all-white soft play, jumping castles, party-fun extras (such as candy carts, popcorn, slush and candy floss) and styled setups for children's parties, plus event styling and coordination for weddings and other celebrations by arrangement. Availability, delivery and the final total are confirmed with each customer before a booking is reserved. Quotations are handled over WhatsApp.

Key facts:
- Business: Lana Luxe Events
- Location served: Johannesburg and Pretoria, South Africa (delivery confirmed by suburb)
- Service areas: Bryanston, Sandton City area, Randburg, Midrand, Johannesburg northern suburbs, Pretoria, Centurion, Germiston
- Services: soft play hire, jumping castle hire, party fun hire (candy cart, popcorn, slush, candy floss), kids party hire packages, bubble house hire, event styling and coordination
- Prices are published in South African Rand (ZAR) on each hire option.
- Enquiry flow: choose an item, share event date and suburb, then continue to WhatsApp to confirm availability and the final total.
- WhatsApp: +27 64 544 0804
- Phone: +27 76 126 5694
- Email: hello@lanaluxeevents.co.za
- Languages: English (website); enquiries welcome in multiple South African languages.

## Hire
- [Party hire collection](https://www.lanaluxeevents.co.za/collection): Full catalogue of hire items with prices and inclusions.
- [Soft play hire](https://www.lanaluxeevents.co.za/soft-play-hire): All-white soft play setups for younger children.
- [Jumping castle hire](https://www.lanaluxeevents.co.za/jumping-castle-hire): Classic, white dome and castle-with-furniture options.
- [Party fun hire](https://www.lanaluxeevents.co.za/party-fun-hire): Candy carts, popcorn, slush and candy floss machines.
- [Party hire packages](https://www.lanaluxeevents.co.za/party-hire-packages): Kids Party Combos sized by number of children.
- [Bubble house hire](https://www.lanaluxeevents.co.za/bubble-house-hire): Clear bubble house setups styled with balloons.
